review_reason: This new immutable V3 brief addresses every RC1-RC6 item in the consumed V2 REQUIRE_CHANGES response. The scientific question and all frozen conditions are unchanged.

frozen_scientific_conditions.cohort: same 60 reused synthetic DEV episodes, five families x 12
frozen_scientific_conditions.primary: length-bucketed B32 teacher-forced GRID_CONTENT equal-family macro

remediation.RC1: Selected causal target positions remain on GPU and are promoted to FP32 there. Correct-token gather, strict-greater rank, masked max-incorrect margin, and only scalar aggregates transfer to CPU; no BxSxV CPU list conversion remains.
remediation.RC2: First-free-running-error reads the condition-specific frozen continuation. It persists only error index, component, rank, margin, and parser status. CPU coverage includes V7 exact versus Family-Balanced error.
remediation.RC3: Outer launcher uses a process-group deadline spanning worker execution; timeout terminates the worker, preserves partial evidence, writes TIMEOUT_NO_UPDATE, and forbids retry. The worker keeps its internal deadline.
remediation.RC4: Binding/config fix nonce, output and receipt, B1 IDs, source code hash set, input/checkpoint hashes and sidecar SHA. Launcher requires clean tracked checkout and LOCAL_HEAD=ORIGIN_REF=RunPod checkout before import; source hashes independently protect functional code identity.
remediation.RC5: Postprocessor now emits equal-family points and CIs, five family cells, pooled token micro, GRID/ROW_SEPARATOR/EOS results, first-error summaries, descriptive exact groups, and protected-family harm override.
remediation.RC6: CPU tests cover condition-specific first error, no-model identity failure, timeout termination, immutable source/hash binding, complete result schema, protected-family harm override, partition/causal alignment, pairing, sensitivity and bootstrap.

interpretation: All results remain development evidence on an already exposed synthetic cohort. They cannot establish independent ARC transfer, causal gradient interference, or model capability improvement by themselves.
director_question: Are the RC1-RC6 repairs and this exact immutable RUN_001 binding sufficient to authorize exactly one no-update, 900-second GPU measurement under the unchanged frozen protocol?
